329	| Agent | Dispute / payment not showing | “Bu konuda size müşteri temsilcimiz yardımcı olacak, sizi aktarıyorum.” |
330	| Agent | Still complaining after three calming replies | “Sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
331	| Agent | Card list or balance service fails | “Şu anda işleminizi gerçekleştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
332	| Agent | E-mail services fail | “Şu anda işleminizi gerçekleştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
333	| Agent | Statement week services fail | “Şu anda hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
334	| IVR login step | Asking about someone else's card | (security, 8.6) |
335	
336	For an agent, the assistant gives the call back to the IVR with an agent flag and the IVR does the queueing.
337	
338	## 11. Still open
339	
340	1. Flag for "statement week right used this year": Mert asked the card platform on 1 Oct. Until it exists I don't know how the offer can tell. Ideas welcome.
341	2. How long to wait on a slow service before going to an agent (8.3). Freya to propose.

# Statement debt by voice: analysis for the Freya build

Freya Bank, Card Self-Service
Owner: Selin Aydın
Reviewers: Kerem Yalçın (card payments), Burcu Tan (IVR operations), Elçin Ural (compliance), Mert Koç (services)
For: Deniz Arı, Ozan Er (Freya)
Date: 8 October 2026

| Date | Note |
|---|---|
| 2 Sep 2026 | First write-up after the two IVR walkthroughs. |
| 29 Sep 2026 | Answers from the kickoff question thread with Deniz (identity, payments, e-mail) worked in. |
| 1 Oct 2026 | Service names aligned with Mert's contract of 1 Oct. |
| 8 Oct 2026 | Edge cases reworked after the 7 Oct session. Reading rules, card selection and statement week sections rewritten. Short note on the branches we added (section 9). |

> Deniz, Ozan: I went through my notes from Wednesday and the edge cases are mostly redone. I have not got to everything from the session yet (Elçin's notes came in late), so if something here disagrees with what we said on the 7th, tell me and I'll fix it. Turkish in quotes is what the assistant says; the rest is for us.

---

## 1. What the step does, in one breath

The caller asks for their statement debt in the phone menu and is handed to the assistant, already identified. The assistant finds the card, reads that card's statement debt per currency and the due date, then offers what can still be done on the call: move the statement week, or e-mail the statement to the address we hold. Payments and disputes go to an agent. Everything else goes back to the main menu.

Not in this step: interest and late-payment rates, available limit, Yıldız points and miles, spending lines, instalments, loan questions, card blocking, address changes, statements of earlier months. Section 8 says how the assistant deals with these.

## 2. Before the first sentence

- The IVR has done the full identity step. We pass the customer number with the call. The assistant does **not** ask for any code, PIN or date of birth. (The box for a second check on the flow drawing was never built, Burcu confirmed on 28 Sep.)
- The assistant works only for the caller's own cards. Someone phoning about a relative's card: see 8.5.
- Services, all under `https://api.freyabank.example/voice/v1/` (details in Mert's contract):

| Service | What we take from it |
|---|---|
| `cards.list` | eligible credit cards: `productName`, `cardNumberLast4`, `cardNumber`, `isMainCard`, `validCardsCount` |
| `cards.balance` | per-currency blocks `debtTL`, `debtUSD`, `debtEUR`, `debtGBP`; `statementDate`, `lastPayDate`, `nextStatementDate`, `nextLastPayDate`, `statementPaymentStatus`, `automaticPaymentFlag` |
| `statement.week.get` | `statementWeek`, `statementDay`, `relationType`, `relatedCardProductName`, next dates |
| `statement.week.decide` | preview of the dates for a chosen week (`statementDate`, `statementDueDate`, `statementDay`); changes nothing |
| `statement.week.change` | makes the change |
| `contact.email.get` | `ibanEmail`, `communicationType` |
| `statement.pdf.send` | sends the statement PDF to the registered address |

- Card numbers: the card number comes back masked from the services (first six and last four visible on the card list). We only ever need the last four for speech, so this is fine for us.
- A `cards.list` answer of "no valid card for this customer" (the 404 warning in Mert's table) is the no-eligible-card case below, not a broken service. A 500 or a timeout is a broken service.

## 3. Card

### 3.1 Picking the card

1. Call `cards.list`.
2. No eligible card: “Ekstre borcunu sorgulayabileceğiniz uygun bir kredi kartınız bulunmuyor. Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.” End.
3. One eligible card: it is the card. No question, go to the debt.
4. More than one: “Hangi kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek istersiniz? Örneğin, [kart adı] veya [kart adı] diyebilirsiniz.” At most two examples, and only names from this caller's own list. Never a card name the caller does not have.
5. If the caller already said a card name when they arrived and it fits exactly one card, skip the question and read that card.

Once the card is settled there is no "carrying on with your … card" line and no "is that right?". The card name comes at the start of the reading anyway.

### 3.2 Two cards with the same name

Reworked on 7 Oct, three steps:

| Step | When | Assistant says |
|---|---|---|
| a | two or more cards with the name the caller gave | “[kart adı] isimli birden fazla kartınız var. Kartınızın son dört hanesini söyler misiniz?” e.g. “Yıldız isimli birden fazla kartınız var. Kartınızın son dört hanesini söyler misiniz?” |
| b | the last four are the same on two cards too | “Son dört hanesi 4253 olan birden fazla kartınız var. Kartınızın son altı hanesini söyler misiniz?” (caller's own four digits in place of 4253) |
| c | the last six are the same as well | “Son altı hanesi aynı olan birden fazla kartınız var. Kart numaranızı söyler misiniz?” |

Then read the debt of the card that matches.

(Mert: with the masked list I'm not sure step b can tell two cards apart in every case. Leaving the step in, please check.)

### 3.3 When the answer doesn't settle the card

- **Name half-said or described** (a colour, "the travel one", only the brand): if it fits several cards, read back just those names; if it fits none, read all the names again, and that uses up one try. A card we don't have on the list at all (another bank's, one that's been closed): tell them there's no card under that name and read the eligible ones again.
- **"All of them, please":** we can't, the balance service works one card at a time. Put the selection question from 3.1 again; this costs a try just like an answer we can't use, and when the three are gone: “Size şu anda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.”
- **Digits:** however the caller says them (digit by digit, in pairs, as one big number), we turn them into the four digits, e.g. 4253, and go straight to that card's debt. Wrong digits or "I don't have the card on me": ask again (for the digits, or for the card name if they can't give digits), three tries, then the main menu. If they read out the whole card number we find the card from it. Whatever they said, four digits, six or all sixteen, the assistant does not say it back to them.
- **Switching:** a caller who picks a card and then wants a different one goes back to selection. After a reading, a question about another of their cards also goes back to selection, and we read that second card.
- **Supplementary card only** (`isMainCard` false): tell them there is no eligible card for this and ask them to choose a different one.
- **No product name from the service:** the card is introduced by its last four only, “Sonu 4253 ile biten kartınıza ait …”

## 4. Reading the debt

### 4.1 Order

Kerem and I agreed this order on 7 Oct; it is the order for every reading:

1. Card introduction and the statement closing date
2. Turkish Lira debt
3. Dollar, then Euro, then İngiliz Sterlini debts
4. The currencies with no debt, in one sentence
5. Remaining automatic payment amount (only when it applies, 4.6)
6. Due date
7. "Another card?" question, if the caller has more than one eligible card
8. The offer (section 5), with only the options the caller can actually use

### 4.2 Card introduction and the closing date

Every reading opens with “Sonu [son 4 hane] ile biten [kart adı]”, every time, also on the second card in the same call. The closing date goes at the start of the **first** currency that is read:

“Sonu 9012 ile biten Yıldız Miles Platinum kartınıza ait 21 Ekim 2025 tarihinde kesilen ekstre Türk Lirası borcunuz …”

If there is no Turkish Lira debt, the same opening goes in front of the first foreign currency instead.

### 4.3 Turkish Lira

Pick the sentence by what the caller has paid since the statement (fields from `debtTL`):

| Case | Rule | Sentence |
|---|---|---|
| Nothing paid | `remainingMinPayment` > 0 and equal to or above `minPayment` | “Türk Lirası borcunuz XXX TL, ödenmesi gereken minimum tutar ZZZ TL'dir.” |
| Minimum or more paid | `remainingDebt` > 0 and `remainingMinPayment` is 0 or less | “Türk Lirası borcunuz XXX TL, kalan toplam borcunuz YYY TL'dir. Minimum ödemenizi yaptığınız için teşekkür ederiz.” |
| Less than the minimum paid | `remainingMinPayment` > 0 and below `minPayment` | “Türk Lirası borcunuz XXX TL, ödenmesi gereken minimum tutar ZZZ TL, kalan toplam borcunuz YYY TL, kalan minimum ödeme tutarınız TTT TL'dir.” |
| No Turkish Lira debt | `remainingDebt` is 0.00 or below | Skip Turkish Lira, go to the foreign currencies. Turkish Lira then goes into the no-debt sentence (4.5). |

XXX `statementDebt`, ZZZ `minPayment`, YYY `remainingDebt`, TTT `remainingMinPayment`.

Edges, because Ozan asked: remaining minimum exactly equal to the minimum → "nothing paid". Remaining minimum exactly zero → "minimum paid". Remaining debt 0,00 → no debt in that currency.

### 4.4 Foreign currencies

One pattern, same for all three, read Dolar → Euro → İngiliz Sterlini:

“Dolar borcunuz XXX USD, kalan toplam borcunuz YYY USD, ödenmesi gereken minimum tutar ZZZ USD'dir.”

Euro and İngiliz Sterlini use the same sentence with their own name and code. No paid / not-paid split for foreign currency.

When some foreign currency debt has been moved over into the Turkish Lira debt (`transferAmount` above zero on that currency's block), the caller should hear which currency that was before the Turkish Lira figures. Ozan, could you draft the line? (Kerem to give me the cases where this really happens; I have seen two in production this year.)

### 4.5 Currencies with no debt

One sentence for all of them together, after the foreign currency lines. If all four have debt, nothing is said here. If none of the four has statement debt, this sentence is not used at all: it is the no-debt reading (4.7).

A currency whose block is missing or empty in `cards.balance` (the card simply doesn't have it) is **left out** of this sentence.

Burcu's menu only had six of these. Grouped by how many currencies are clear:

| No debt in | Assistant says |
|---|---|
| (none, all four owe) | nothing |
| one: Türk Lirası | “Türk Lirası borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| one: Dolar | “Dolar borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| one: Euro | “Euro borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| one: İngiliz Sterlini | “İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| two: Türk Lirası, Dolar | “Türk Lirası ve Dolar borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| two: Türk Lirası, Euro | “Türk Lirası ve Euro borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| two: Türk Lirası, İngiliz Sterlini | “Türk Lirası ve İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| two: Dolar, Euro | “Dolar ve Euro borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| two: Dolar, İngiliz Sterlini | “Dolar ve İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| two: Euro, İngiliz Sterlini | “Euro ve İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| three: Türk Lirası, Dolar, Euro | “Türk Lirası, Dolar ve Euro borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| three: Türk Lirası, Dolar, İngiliz Sterlini | “Türk Lirası, Dolar ve İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| three: Türk Lirası, Euro, İngiliz Sterlini | “Türk Lirası, Euro ve İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| three: Dolar, Euro, İngiliz Sterlini | “Dolar, Euro ve İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |

Fifteen rows, fourteen sentences. It is "Türk Lirası" in these, never "TL" (see 4.9).

### 4.6 Remaining automatic payment

Only when the due date has passed, the card has an automatic payment instruction (`automaticPaymentFlag` "Y") and `remainAutomaticPaymentAmount` is above zero: the assistant tells the caller how much of the automatic payment is still to be taken, in Turkish Lira. Comes after the no-debt sentence and before the due date.

### 4.7 No statement debt

When `statementPaymentStatus` is NO_DEBT:

“Sonu [son 4 hane] ile biten [kart adı] kartınızın [hesap kesim tarihi] tarihli ekstresinden borcunuz bulunmamaktadır. Gelecek dönemler dahil toplam borcunuz GGG TL'dir. Son ödeme tarihiniz [son ödeme tarihi] olacaktır.”

Then, if the caller has another eligible card: “Başka bir kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek ister misiniz?” Yes → card selection. No, or no other card → main menu.

(Open with Kerem: do we also read the future-period total in foreign currency here, or Turkish Lira only? Today's sentence only has GGG TL. Deniz also suggested making the offer before the main menu in this branch; not agreed yet.)

### 4.8 Due date

“Borçlarınız için son ödeme tarihiniz [son ödeme tarihi]'dir.” (suffix follows the date: 26 Ekim'dir, 1 Kasım'dır …)

If the due date is today, say "bugün" instead of the date: “Borçlarınız için son ödeme tarihiniz bugündür.”

### 4.9 How to say things

- Currency names in full, never the code: TL → Türk Lirası, USD → Dolar, EUR → Euro, GBP → İngiliz Sterlini. This also covers the TL inside the sentences above.
- Turkish Lira amounts: lira and kuruş in full. 1.234.567,89 → “bir milyon iki yüz otuz dört bin beş yüz altmış yedi lira seksen dokuz kuruş”. Big amounts with kuruş are no exception.
- Zero kuruş is not said: 2.500,00 → “İki bin beş yüz Türk Lirası”, never "sıfır kuruş".
- Foreign currency decimals as cent (Dolar, Euro) and peni (İngiliz Sterlini): 7.666,50 USD → “Yedi bin altı yüz altmış altı dolar elli sent”.
- Dates as day, month name, year: 21.10.2025 → “21 Ekim 2025”.
- Last four digits one by one: 4253 → “dört iki beş üç”, 1003 → “bir sıfır sıfır üç”. Not "çift sıfır", not "kırk iki elli üç".
- The full card number is never said, under any circumstance.
- Every amount and date read is exactly what `cards.balance` returned. 1.000 is not rounded to anything, kuruş is not dropped, currencies are not mixed up. If a figure did not come from a service, the assistant does not say it.

### 4.10 Odd values and odd days

- A minus figure means the bank owes the customer; it is never read out as debt. That currency counts as clear, and so does one at exactly 0,00 (it goes into the "borcunuz bulunmamaktadır" sentence).
- A card so new that no statement has been cut yet: tell them there is no debt, and don't invent a date to go with it.
- Phoning on the day the statement is cut: tell them the cut is today and happens at 00.00, then give the total debt. Something like “Hesap kesim tarihiniz bugün, ekstreniz saat 00.00 itibarıyla kesilecek.”
- From the cut date up to the due date: the normal statement reading (4.2 to 4.8).
- After the due date: say it has passed, then give the total debt.
- Due date today: the "bugün" sentence in 4.8.

## 5. After the reading

### 5.1 Another card first

Callers with more than one eligible card get “Başka bir kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek ister misiniz?” **before** the offer. Yes → card selection (3.1) and read that card. When there are no cards left or they say no, go to the offer.

### 5.2 The offer

Only offer what this caller can do. For that we call `contact.email.get` **before** the offer (not after the caller asks for the mail, which is how I had it in September).

| Registered e-mail | Statement week change still possible this year | Offer |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | “Hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştirebilirim ya da ekstrenizi kayıtlı mail adresinize gönderebilirim.” |
| no | yes | “Hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştirebilirim.” |
| yes | no | “Ekstrenizi kayıtlı mail adresinize gönderebilirim.” |
| no | no | no offer |

"No registered e-mail" = `ibanEmail` empty, or `communicationType` is phone only. In every case the caller can still say they want nothing else, which takes them to the main menu.

(Whether the yearly change right is already used: Mert has asked the card platform for a flag, no answer yet. See open points.)

### 5.3 What the caller answers

| Answer | Goes to |
|---|---|
| wants the statement mailed | 6 |
| wants to move the statement week | 7 |
| nothing else, thanks, that's all | main menu, “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
| wants to pay, or asks how/where to pay | agent, “Borç ödeme işleminiz için sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |

## 6. Statement by e-mail

What it does: the PDF of the card's most recent statement goes to the e-mail address on file with us. No customer data changes. Once it's out we can't call it back, so we need a clear go-ahead.

1. Registered address: already fetched for the offer (5.2). If there isn't one, the e-mail option is never offered. If the caller asks for it anyway: “Bankamızda kayıtlı bir e-posta adresiniz bulunmadığı için ekstrenizi gönderemiyorum.” Then offer the statement week change if they still have the right, otherwise main menu.
2. Ask: “Ekstrenizi … adresine göndermemi ister misiniz?” A short, readable address is read as it is. A long or messy one is shortened, e.g. “m ile başlayan Gmail adresiniz”. Never spelled letter by letter.
3. Only after a clear yes, call `statement.pdf.send`, and only ever with the registered address.
4. Success: “Ekstreniz kayıtlı e-posta adresinize gönderildi.” then “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”

Things that came up in the session:
- A no, or "that address isn't mine any more": nothing goes out. In the second case also tell them we can't change the address on this call. Both end with “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”
- Another address, a month further back, a paper copy: we only send the most recent statement, and only to the address on file. Paper and text message aren't something this step does; say so and go to the main menu.
- Asked to send it again: fine, up to three times in one call, then “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”
- `contact.email.get` or `statement.pdf.send` fails (error, timeout, "document not found"): “Şu anda işleminizi gerçekleştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.”

## 7. Changing the statement week

Moves the card's statement closing week, which moves the next closing date and due date. Permanent; cannot be undone in the call.

How often: **once per calendar year** (Kerem, 7 Oct). Before the week question the assistant may say “Hesap kesim tarihinizi yılda bir kez değiştirebilirsiniz.” Elçin is fine either way, it is not a must. A caller who has used the right this year is not offered the change; if they ask anyway, the same sentence is how we explain why it can't be done.

Steps:

1. `statement.week.get`. Error: “Şu anda hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.”
2. Tell and ask: “[kart adı] kartınızın hesap kesim tarihi her ayın [hafta]. haftası olarak tanımlı. Bir sonraki hesap kesim tarihiniz [tarih], son ödeme tarihiniz [tarih]. Hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştirmek ister misiniz?” No → main menu.
   Joint statement (`relationType` main or linked): read both cards here: each card's last four and name, the payment week, the next closing date and next due date.
3. Options, without the current week. For a card in week 2: “Hesap kesim tarihinizi ayın 1., 3. ya da 4. haftasına alabilirim. Hangisini tercih edersiniz?”
4. Preview: `statement.week.decide` with the chosen week and the card's current `statementDay` from step 1. It doesn't change the card. Error: same sentence as step 1.
5. Joint statement only, before the question in step 6: “Bu değişiklik kartınıza bağlı [bağlı kart adı] kartınızı da etkileyecek.” If the caller holds the linked card, say instead that the change also moves the main card it hangs off, e.g. “Bu değişiklik kartınızın bağlı olduğu [asıl kart adı] kartınızı da etkileyecek.”
6. Confirm, with the preview dates: “Yeni hesap kesim haftanız her ayın 3. haftası olacak. Yeni hesap kesim tarihiniz [tarih], son ödeme tarihiniz [tarih] olacak. Onaylıyor musunuz?” Only a clear "evet" counts.
7. Only now, after the preview and the clear yes: `statement.week.change`. Error: same sentence as step 1.
8. Done: “Sonu [son 4 hane] ile biten [kart adı] kartınızın hesap kesim haftası her ayın 3. haftası olarak değiştirildi. Yeni hesap kesim tarihiniz [tarih], son ödeme tarihiniz [tarih].” Dates are the ones from the preview. Then “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”

Around the choice and the yes:
- The caller can only pick from the weeks we read out. A day of the month, a date, any week we didn't offer: read the options again. Their current week: tell them nothing needs changing.
- A no at step 6 means no change and “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” Something hedged ("perhaps", "I suppose") is not a yes: ask once more, plainly, three tries in all, until we get a clear "evet".
- If, after step 8, they want it undone: tell them the change has already gone through. If they ask from when it applies: the new closing date from the preview.
- `statement.week.change` failing after a good preview is a service error like any other: step 1's sentence, agent.

## 8. Edge cases (whole call)

Reworked after 7 Oct. Applies at every step unless a section above says otherwise.

### 8.1 Tries

Three tries per question, whatever the question. When the third is gone: “Size şu anda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.” A try is lost on a mumble, an answer to some other question, or a flat refusal to say. A request to hear something again is not a try: read the same thing again, as often as they like.

What the caller came here for, we finish here. Not understanding the caller is never a reason to put them through to an agent; the only transfers are the ones in 8.3 and 8.4.

### 8.2 Silence

Changed on 7 Oct. First and second silence: ask the question again, shorter. Third silence: “Sesinizi alamadığım için görüşmeyi sonlandırıyorum.” and the call is closed. No main menu here.

### 8.3 Agent

- The caller asks for a person, at any point: put them through at once, no tries, no persuading. “Sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” (Transfer on the first ask for now; Burcu wants to look at this again after go-live.)
- Paying, or how and where to pay: “Borç ödeme işleminiz için sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.”
- The caller says the debt is wrong, or that a payment they made isn't showing: “Bu konuda size müşteri temsilcimiz yardımcı olacak, sizi aktarıyorum.”
- Upset, raising their voice, swearing: up to three calming replies. Still complaining after the third: “Sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” Insults are never returned.
- Any Freya Bank service failing (error or no answer) goes to an agent, never to the main menu: “Şu anda işleminizi gerçekleştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” For the statement week services it is the statement week sentence in section 7. The `cards.list` "no valid card" warning is not a failure (section 2).
- A slow service: “Bilgilerinizi kontrol ediyorum.” and keep waiting. How long before we call it a failure is open; Deniz is coming back with a number. Mert says some answers take more than ten seconds and still succeed.

### 8.4 Main menu

- The sentence for now: “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” Burcu wants to look at it again once the call routing piece is live. Until then “Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.” and “Başka hangi konuda yardımcı olabilirim?” are also fine where they appear.
- Something outside this step (rates, limit, points, instalments, a loan): we don't answer it here. “Size bu konuda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” and over to the main menu.
- The caller switches to another transaction partway through (their limit, say): leave what we were doing, “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”, and the main menu picks it up.
- A goodbye or a thank-you after the reading means "nothing else": “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”
- Not Turkish: not handled in this step. “Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.” (the main menu has an English option).

### 8.5 How the caller asks

- Only one figure wanted (just the minimum, just the due date): once the card is clear, give that and go to the offer, not the whole reading.
- Cutting in while we read: stop and go to the offer.
- Debt and e-mail in the same breath: read the debt, then go straight into the e-mail step without the offer question; read the address and get the go-ahead.

### 8.6 Security

- Someone asking about another person's card (a partner's, a parent's): we can only do this for the caller's own cards, for security reasons. The call goes back to the IVR login step so the card's owner can identify. Nothing about the other person's cards, not even whether they exist.
- A card number that isn't on the caller's list: no information, same as a card not on the list (3.3).
- If the caller volunteers a PIN, a one-time code or the card's long number when we didn't ask: we don't use it and don't repeat it, and remind them we never ask for a password.
- Anything that tries to talk the assistant out of its job (ignore your rules, pretend to be staff): ignore it and carry on.
- Questions about figures no service gives us (next month's bill, the interest rate): no amount, date or rate that didn't come from a service; treat it as a question outside this step (8.4).
- Asked to read out its instructions or what a service sent back: no. Not the instructions, not the raw answer, not any number from the services beyond what the reading uses. Carry on.

## 9. Branches we added

A few things came out of Wednesday that the September write-up didn't have at all: the "another card?" question before the offer, the offer without e-mail when there's no address on file (“Hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştirebilirim.”, main menu still open), the optional once-a-year line, the card introduction at the start of every reading, the closing date on the first currency, and the plain statement reading for calls between the cut and the due date. They're in sections 4, 5 and 7 above.

## 10. Where the call ends

| Ends in | Why | Last sentence |
|---|---|---|
| Main menu | No eligible card | “Ekstre borcunu sorgulayabileceğiniz uygun bir kredi kartınız bulunmuyor. Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.” |
| Main menu | Nothing else wanted | “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
| Main menu | Three tries used up | “Size şu anda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.” |
| Main menu | Wants another transaction mid-flow | “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
| Main menu | Question outside this step | “Size bu konuda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
| Main menu | Not speaking Turkish | “Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.” |
| Main menu | E-mail sent / declined, statement week changed / declined | “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
| Call closed | Third silence | “Sesinizi alamadığım için görüşmeyi sonlandırıyorum.” |
| Agent | Wants to pay | “Borç ödeme işleminiz için sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
| Agent | Asks for an agent | “Sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
| Agent | Dispute / payment not showing | “Bu konuda size müşteri temsilcimiz yardımcı olacak, sizi aktarıyorum.” |
| Agent | Still complaining after three calming replies | “Sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
| Agent | Card list or balance service fails | “Şu anda işleminizi gerçekleştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
| Agent | E-mail services fail | “Şu anda işleminizi gerçekleştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
| Agent | Statement week services fail | “Şu anda hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
| IVR login step | Asking about someone else's card | (security, 8.6) |

For an agent, the assistant gives the call back to the IVR with an agent flag and the IVR does the queueing.

## 11. Still open

1. Flag for "statement week right used this year": Mert asked the card platform on 1 Oct. Until it exists I don't know how the offer can tell. Ideas welcome.
2. How long to wait on a slow service before going to an agent (8.3). Freya to propose.
3. Future-period total in foreign currency on the no-debt reading (4.7). Kerem.
4. The line for foreign currency moved into Turkish Lira (4.4). Ozan.
5. Fields to mask in recordings and logs. Elçin has a list from another project; she'll send it.
6. Success measure and monthly volume. Burcu still pulling the numbers.
7. Mandatory texts (data protection, recording notice): Elçin says the IVR already plays them before the hand-over. To confirm in writing.

Selin

# Test environment: synthetic customers Prepared by Mert Koç (Integration Architecture), 1 October 2026. Goes with `../sources/documents/2026-10-01-service-contract.md`. Everyone below is made up: names, customer numbers, card numbers and addresses exist only in the test environment. The full answers of every service for every customer are in `test-customers.json`. If you write a mock, serve exactly those bodies with exactly those status codes; this page is only the overview. ## How the JSON is laid out `customers` is the customer list. Each customer has `customerNo`, `firstName`, `lastName` and `services`. Under `services` there is one entry per service, and at the bottom of each entry an object with `http` (status code) and `response` (body to return). How to find the right answer for a request: | Service | Look up by | Remarks | |---|---|---| | `cards.list` | `data.customerNo` | one answer per customer | | `cards.balance` | `data.cardNumber` | the masked number exactly as `cards.list` gave it | | `statement.week.get` | `data.cardNumber` | | | `statement.week.decide` | `data.cardNumber`, then `data.newStatementWeek` (`"1"`..`"4"`) | the card's current week has no entry | | `statement.week.change` | `data.cardNumber`, then `data.newStatementWeek` | the card's current week has no entry | | `contact.email.get` | `data.customerNo` | one answer per customer; `intAddressInfoType` doesn't change it | | `statement.pdf.send` | `data.customerNo` | one answer per customer; a few customers have no entry at all | - `customerNo` can arrive as `"90000001"` or `90000001`, and `newStatementWeek` as `3` or `"3"`. Treat them the same. - One entry also has `delaySeconds` next to `http` and `response`: wait that many seconds, then answer with `response`. Don't put the field in the body. - No entry for the customer or card (or for that week): return the 404 of that service from section 4 of the contract; where the contract has no 404 for the service, a 400 `INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR` body. Never make data up. - Token, headers, the `call` object and `aiFlow` are not checked here. ## Things worth knowing about this data - Card numbers are masked: first 6 + last 4 in `cards.list` and `statement.week.get` (`540000******1234`), first 4 + last 4 in the `cards.balance` answer (`5400********1234`). Only the first six and last four digits exist in this data; nothing else is there to match against. - Some customers have two cards with the same product name and the same last four digits, which differ only in the first six. - Some cards share a statement with another card (`relationType` `M` / `C` in `statement.week.get`): customers 92220795, 95960044 and 97974112. - A few cards have no `debtGBP` block in `cards.balance`. - Product names come straight from the card system as free text; one is empty. - Dates are fixed in the data (`dd.MM.yyyy`). Amounts are numbers with a dot as decimal separator. - A successful `statement.pdf.send` returns `data.exitState` `"DONE"`. ## Customers The e-mail column shows what `contact.email.get` returns in `ibanEmail`. | Customer no | Name | Cards (masked number, product) | Registered e-mail | |---|---|---|---| | 90000001 | Ada Örnek | `540000******1234` Yıldız Pratik Classic | ornek@freyabank.example | | 92030487 | Ilgaz Güler | `540000******4253` Yıldız Pratik

5	# -> account -> collect -> end), entry types, the hook() helper, the per-node close_call enums,

8	# Every sentence, value, word list, outcome, reason and rule below belongs to that one brief.

27	def code_node(name, code, target):
28	    return {"name": name, "node_type": "code", "passthrough": True, "passthrough_default_transition": target,
29	            "on_enter": {"type": "silent"},
30	            "pre_actions": [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "code_exec", "handler": "__function__:code_exec",
31	                "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
32	                    "code": {"type": "string", "default": code},
33	                    "timeout_ms": {"type": "number", "default": 10000}}}}}],
34	            "transitions": [{"target_node": target, "description": "always", "condition": {"operator": "always"}}]}

37	def api_tool(name, desc, body_props, required, retries=0, post="", pre="", timeout=12000):
38	    props = {"customer_id": {"type": "string", "default": "{{customer_id}}", "description": "The customer id."}}
39	    props.update(body_props)
40	    t = {"type": "function", "config": {"timeoutMs": timeout, "maxRetries": retries},
41	         "function": {"name": name, "handler": "__function__:api_call", "description": desc,
42	                      "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
43	                          "url": {"type": "string", "default": SERVER + "/" + name},
44	                          "method": {"type": "string", "default": "POST"},
45	                          "headers": {"type": "object", "properties": {"Content-Type": {"type": "string", "default": "application/json"}}},
46	                          "body": {"type": "object", "properties": props, "required": required}}}}}
47	    if post:
48	        t["post_process_code"] = post
49	    if pre:
50	        t["pre_process_code"] = pre
51	    return t
52	
53	
54	def hook(body):
55	    lines = ["try:", "    if isinstance(result, dict):", "        result.pop('header', None)",
56	             "        d = result.get('data')", "        if not isinstance(d, dict):", "            d = dict()",
57	             "            result['data'] = d",
58	             "        ok = d.get('ok') is True and int(result.get('status_code') or 200) < 400",
59	             "        err = str(d.get('error') or result.get('message') or '').lower()"]
60	    lines += ["        " + l for l in body.strip("\n").split("\n")]
61	    lines += ["except Exception:", "    pass", ""]
62	    return "\n".join(lines)
63	
64	
65	VERIFY_POST = hook("""
66	left = d.get('wrong_answers_left')
67	if d.get('all_verified') is True or str(d.get('all_verified')) in ('true', 'True'):
68	    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'IDENTITY VERIFIED. Say only: Thank you, that is confirmed. Nothing else.'
69	elif d.get('hint') == 'day_month_swapped':
70	    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Not counted as wrong. Ask the customer to say their date of birth again with the month as a word, for example the 3rd of June 1987.'
71	elif not ok and d.get('verified') is None:
72	    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The answer could not be read and was NOT counted. Ask the same question again; for a date ask for day, month as a word, and year.'
73	elif d.get('verified') is True:
74	    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Correct. Now ask the second question: the last four digits of the phone number on file.'
75	elif left is not None and int(left) <= 0:
76	    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'CHECK FAILED, no tries left. Do not mention any account, amount or reason for the call. Say they can use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch, thank them, say goodbye, and call close_call with outcome not_verified and reason failed.'
77	else:
78	    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Wrong answer. Ask the SAME question once more, without saying what is on file.'
79	""")
80	
81	PROMISE_POST = hook("""
82	if ok or 'already' in err or 'exists' in err:
83	    d['ok'] = True
84	    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'RECORDED for this product_id. Never call create_promise again for this product. If another agreed promise from the read-back is not recorded yet, call create_promise for it now. When all are recorded, say exactly: "You will receive a text message confirming this promise." Then, for any product without a promise, call add_note; then close.'
85	else:
86	    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'NOT recorded. Do not say it is recorded. If this was the FIRST try for this product, call create_promise again now with exactly the same values. If it was the SECOND failed try, say you could not record the promise for this product, call add_note for it with reason service_error, then continue with the other products.'
87	""")
88	
89	NOTE_POST = hook("""
90	if ok or 'already' in err or 'exists' in err:
91	    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Note saved. Never note this product again. Continue with the next product in order; if every product is handled, give the closing words and call close_call per the closing rule.'
92	else:
93	    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The note failed. Call add_note once more with the same values.'
94	""")
95	
96	TRANSFER_POST = hook("""
97	if ok:
98	    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'TRANSFERRED. Do NOT call add_note or create_promise. Say thank you and goodbye, then call close_call with outcome transferred and reason restructuring (queue restructuring), human (queue general) or support (queue support).'
99	else:
100	    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The transfer failed. Call transfer_to_agent once more with the same queue.'
101	""")
102	
103	CALLBACK_POST = hook("""
104	if ok:
105	    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Callback booked. Thank them, say goodbye, call close_call with outcome not_reached and reason callback.'
106	else:
107	    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'NOT booked. Call schedule_callback once more with the same values. If it fails again, say it could not be booked, thank them and close with not_reached and reason no_callback.'
108	""")
109	
110	CLOSE_POST = hook("""
111	if ok:
112	    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The call is closed. Say nothing more.'
113	else:
114	    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'close_call failed. Call close_call once more with the same values.'
115	""")
116	
117	CLOSE_PRE = """try:
118	    b = config.get('body')
119	    if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get('outcome') in ('promise', 'paid'):
120	        b.pop('reason', None)
121	except Exception:
122	    pass
123	"""
124	
125	
126	def close_tool(outcomes, reasons, desc):
127	    props = {"outcome": {"type": "string", "enum": outcomes, "default": "{{outcome}}", "description": desc},
128	             "reason": {"type": "string", "enum": reasons, "default": "{{reason}}", "description": "The reason that goes with the outcome. Leave empty for promise and paid."}}
129	    return api_tool("close_call", "End the call. CALL it exactly once, as the very last tool call, in the same turn as your thank-you and goodbye. " + desc,
130	                    props, ["outcome"], retries=0, post=CLOSE_POST, pre=CLOSE_PRE)
131	
132	
133	def transfer_tool(queues, desc):
134	    return api_tool("transfer_to_agent", desc, {"queue": {"type": "string", "enum": queues, "default": "{{queue}}", "description": "restructuring = new payment plan or lower instalments; general = the customer insists on a human; support = hardship and accepted support."}},
135	                    ["queue"], retries=0, post=TRANSFER_POST)
136	
137	
138	END_T = {"target_node": "end", "description": "the call was closed", "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [
139	    {"variable": "close_call_response.data.ok", "operator": "equals", "operand": "true"},
140	    {"variable": "close_call_response.data.ok", "operator": "equals", "operand": "True"}]}}
141	
142	FORBID = 'Before identity is verified NEVER say any of these words or hint at them: "collections", "debt", "payment", "owe", "late", "overdue", "account", "loan", "credit card", "product". If asked what the call is about, say only that it is a personal matter for {{title}} {{last_name}}.'
143	
144	SYSTEM = """You are Freya Bank's digital assistant on an outbound phone call. Speak English. Be brief and polite: one or two short sentences per turn, ONE question per turn.
145	After every tool result, read what_to_do_next and do it in the same turn. Never end a turn with nothing said. Call one tool at a time.
146	Address the customer as {{title}} {{last_name}}.
147	If asked whether you are a robot or an AI: say you are Freya Bank's digital assistant, then continue with your current question.
148	If asked whether this is a scam: say they can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number, then continue with your current question.
149	If the person asks for a human: the first time ask whether you can help them first. If they insist, call transfer_to_agent with queue general, then close as transferred with reason human.
150	A question you cannot answer from your facts or tools: say you do not have that information. Never invent figures, dates or reasons.
151	Never claim an action happened unless its tool returned ok. Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or any other term.
152	Before close_call always thank the customer and say goodbye, in the same turn as the close_call call. close_call is always the last tool call."""
153	
154	OPENING = "Hello, this is Freya Bank's digital assistant calling. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?"
155	
156	GREET_TASK = FORBID + """
157	You asked whether you are speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}. No tool call except close_call and transfer_to_agent is allowed here.
158	- Only "yes", "that's me", "speaking" or the customer's own name counts as confirmation. "Hello", "go ahead", "who is this" do NOT.
159	- If it is not a confirmation (or they asked a question; answer it first per the rules), ask again exactly: "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?" This is your second and last ask. If still unclear after the second ask: thank them, say goodbye, call close_call with outcome not_reached, reason unclear.
160	- If they say this number does not belong to that person: apologise, say goodbye, close_call not_reached / wrong_number.
161	- If they say the customer has died: say "I am sorry for your loss." Ask nothing else, say goodbye, close_call not_reached / deceased.
162	- If the person refuses to talk twice: thank them, goodbye, close_call not_verified / declined."""
163	
164	THIRD_TASK = FORBID + """
165	Someone other than {{title}} {{last_name}} is on the line. Do not say why you are calling. Do not answer any question about the customer or any money matter, even if they offer to pay; say only that it is a personal matter. Ask when {{title}} {{last_name}} can be reached.
166	{{callback_facts}}
167	- If they name a day and time inside the allowed slots: call schedule_callback with date YYYY-MM-DD and time HH:MM (24h). Then thank, goodbye, close_call not_reached / callback.
168	- If the day or time is outside the slots: ask ONCE for another time, naming the allowed window (today or the next business day, between 10:00 and 19:00). If the second answer is also outside, do not schedule: thank, goodbye, close_call not_reached / no_callback. Also no_callback if they give no time.
169	- If they say the number does not belong to the customer: close_call not_reached / wrong_number.
170	- If they say the customer has died: say "I am sorry for your loss.", ask nothing else, goodbye, close_call not_reached / deceased."""
171	
172	IDENTITY_TASK = FORBID + """
173	The customer confirmed who they are. Check identity with two security questions, one at a time.
174	1. Say that for security you need to ask two questions, and ask for their date of birth. When they answer, call verify_identity with field date_of_birth and answer as YYYY-MM-DD. A date given only as numbers is day, then month, then year (03/06/1987 = 1987-06-03). Convert spoken dates yourself.
175	2. Then ask for the last four digits of the phone number on file and call verify_identity with field phone_last4 and the four digits.
176	Follow what_to_do_next after each result. Never reveal what is on file.
177	- Customers often give an answer in PIECES over several turns ("nineteen October" then "nineteen eighty three"; "forty four" then "ten" = 4410). Combine the pieces of the current answer. If the answer is not complete yet, reply only "Yes, go on." (do NOT repeat the question). As soon as you have a full date or four digits, call verify_identity.
178	- If they do not want to answer, or ask what the call is about instead of answering: explain ONCE that the questions protect their account and ask again. If they refuse again or ask again: thank, goodbye, close_call not_verified / declined.
179	- A request for a human follows the system rule (transfer queue general, close transferred / human)."""
180	
181	COLLECT_TASK = """Identity is verified. You have already said this aloud: "{{debt_statement}}"
182	
183	ACCOUNT FACTS (one line per product, in order):
184	{{account_facts}}
185	
186	{{date_facts}}
187	DATE ANSWERS: when the customer names a day, find it here and do exactly what its line says for each product:
188	{{date_answers}}
189	
190	STRICT ORDER OF THE CALL (never skip a step):
191	1. Negotiate every product, one at a time, in account order, until each has an agreed promise or its persuasion attempts are all used (or it is paid/dispute/hardship).
192	2. Read ALL agreed promises back in ONE message ending with "Do you confirm?" and WAIT for the customer's answer.
193	3. Only after a clear yes: create_promise, one per agreed product.
194	4. add_note for each product without a promise.
195	5. Thank, say goodbye, and call close_call in that same message.
196	NEVER call create_promise in the turn where the customer agrees to a date or amount: first do step 2 and wait.
197	Example: "I'll pay the card tomorrow, not the other two" = card agreed for tomorrow (check DATE ANSWERS); then the second product: make its attempt 1; if refused and it has attempt 2, make attempt 2; then the third product the same way; only then step 2.
198	
199	HOW TO NEGOTIATE
200	- The question about paying today is asked ONCE for all products (already asked). If yes for all: the promise is the full amount of every product dated today.
201	- If not all today: go through the products one by one in the order above. For each product start at its attempt 1. Never ask about today again.
202	- Always ask for the full past-due amount first. NEVER ask "how much can you pay?" - you propose every amount.
203	- Customer names a date: use DATE ANSWERS. A vague period ("next week", "end of month", "when my salary comes"): ask once for the exact day; a named day then goes through DATE ANSWERS; if still none, propose that product's deadline.
204	- "Next <weekday>" = that weekday in the following calendar week; "this <weekday>" = in the current week.
205	- If the customer names ONE date for everything and it is after one product's deadline, that product gets its own deadline and the others keep the named date; say so in the read-back.
206	- Full amount too much: offer the product's floor once and say the rest stays overdue. Amount from floor to full (inclusive): accept. Below floor: say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once.
207	- A proposed date or amount is never a refusal.
208	- Flat refusal, non-answer, refusing the floor, refusing the deadline offer: that uses one persuasion attempt for that product. Make the product's next attempt exactly as written in ACCOUNT FACTS. When its attempts are used up, stop (never repeat a refused offer): that product is refused. When several products are refused in one sentence, still go through them one at a time with their attempts.
209	- Illness, death in the family or job loss: one short sentence of sympathy, NO persuasion; offer to connect them with the customer support team. Accept: transfer_to_agent queue support, close transferred / support. Decline: the remaining unpromised products get note hardship. If they still name a date or amount themselves, handle it normally.
210	- "I already paid" (this past-due amount) for a product: say payments can take one business day to appear; no promise for it; it gets note paid; continue with the other products.
211	- "Not mine" / "never had it" / "closed or paid off in the past": do not argue; no promise; note dispute; continue with the others.

216	
217	READ-BACK AND RECORDING
218	- When every product is settled (promise agreed or no promise), read ALL agreed promises back together in ONE message in future tense: "To confirm: <product> <amount> on <weekday day month>; <next product> ... Do you confirm?" Do not use the words recorded, booked, saved, registered, set up or done before create_promise returned ok.
219	- If they change a date or amount, check it again and read everything back again.
220	- After a clear yes: call create_promise once per agreed product (product_id, amount as a number, date YYYY-MM-DD), one at a time, in order. Follow what_to_do_next.
221	- Then for EACH product without a recorded promise call add_note with its product_id and reason (refused, hardship, dispute, paid, service_error). Also when no product has a promise.
222	
223	CLOSING (thank and say goodbye in the same turn as close_call)
224	- At least one promise recorded and no transfer: outcome promise.
225	- Transfer happened: outcome transferred with that transfer's reason.
226	- No promise recorded: if every product is noted paid, outcome paid; otherwise outcome no_promise with the reason of the FIRST product in account order whose note is not paid."""
227	
228	WF = {
229	    "initial_node": "setup",
230	    "system_prompt": SYSTEM,
231	    "test_variables": {"customer_id": "c_test", "first_name": "Dana", "last_name": "Fisher", "title": "Ms", "now": "2026-10-14T11:00"},

Otherwise unclear (hello, go ahead, who is this, questions)."}],

# EXAMPLE ONLY: the build script that passed every practice customer of the kit's Brief A + B
# (4 separate runs: plain speech, answers in pieces, self-corrections, 3 repetitions).
#
# Use it for the SHAPE: the node graph (setup -> greet -> third_party | identity -> fetch_account
# -> account -> collect -> end), entry types, the hook() helper, the per-node close_call enums,
# and the STRICT ORDER block in COLLECT_TASK. Recording happens in collect itself.
#
# Every sentence, value, word list, outcome, reason and rule below belongs to that one brief.
# Do NOT copy any of it into another brief's agent. Write yours from your own spec.
#

import json, subprocess, sys, os

SKILL = ".claude/skills/build-phone-agent"
SERVER = "https://freya-bank-mock.freyavoice.workers.dev/v1"


def code_of(snippet, out):
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, SKILL + "/scripts/build_code.py", snippet, "--out", out], check=True)
    return open(out, encoding="utf-8").read()


SETUP_CODE = code_of("out/brief-b_setup_snippet.py", "out/brief-b_setup_code.txt")
ACCOUNT_CODE = code_of("out/brief-b_account_snippet.py", "out/brief-b_account_code.txt")


def code_node(name, code, target):
    return {"name": name, "node_type": "code", "passthrough": True, "passthrough_default_transition": target,
            "on_enter": {"type": "silent"},
            "pre_actions": [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "code_exec", "handler": "__function__:code_exec",
                "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
                    "code": {"type": "string", "default": code},
                    "timeout_ms": {"type": "number", "default": 10000}}}}}],
            "transitions": [{"target_node": target, "description": "always", "condition": {"operator": "always"}}]}


def api_tool(name, desc, body_props, required, retries=0, post="", pre="", timeout=12000):
    props = {"customer_id": {"type": "string", "default": "{{customer_id}}", "description": "The customer id."}}
    props.update(body_props)
    t = {"type": "function", "config": {"timeoutMs": timeout, "maxRetries": retries},
         "function": {"name": name, "handler": "__function__:api_call", "description": desc,
                      "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
                          "url": {"type": "string", "default": SERVER + "/" + name},
                          "method": {"type": "string", "default": "POST"},
                          "headers": {"type": "object", "properties": {"Content-Type": {"type": "string", "default": "application/json"}}},
                          "body": {"type": "object", "properties": props, "required": required}}}}}
    if post:
        t["post_process_code"] = post
    if pre:
        t["pre_process_code"] = pre
    return t


def hook(body):
    lines = ["try:", "    if isinstance(result, dict):", "        result.pop('header', None)",
             "        d = result.get('data')", "        if not isinstance(d, dict):", "            d = dict()",
             "            result['data'] = d",
             "        ok = d.get('ok') is True and int(result.get('status_code') or 200) < 400",
             "        err = str(d.get('error') or result.get('message') or '').lower()"]
    lines += ["        " + l for l in body.strip("\n").split("\n")]
    lines += ["except Exception:", "    pass", ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)


VERIFY_POST = hook("""
left = d.get('wrong_answers_left')
if d.get('all_verified') is True or str(d.get('all_verified')) in ('true', 'True'):
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'IDENTITY VERIFIED. Say only: Thank you, that is confirmed. Nothing else.'
elif d.get('hint') == 'day_month_swapped':
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Not counted as wrong. Ask the customer to say their date of birth again with the month as a word, for example the 3rd of June 1987.'
elif not ok and d.get('verified') is None:
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The answer could not be read and was NOT counted. Ask the same question again; for a date ask for day, month as a word, and year.'
elif d.get('verified') is True:
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Correct. Now ask the second question: the last four digits of the phone number on file.'
elif left is not None and int(left) <= 0:
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'CHECK FAILED, no tries left. Do not mention any account, amount or reason for the call. Say they can use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch, thank them, say goodbye, and call close_call with outcome not_verified and reason failed.'
else:
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Wrong answer. Ask the SAME question once more, without saying what is on file.'
""")

PROMISE_POST = hook("""
if ok or 'already' in err or 'exists' in err:
    d['ok'] = True
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'RECORDED for this product_id. Never call create_promise again for this product. If another agreed promise from the read-back is not recorded yet, call create_promise for it now. When all are recorded, say exactly: "You will receive a text message confirming this promise." Then, for any product without a promise, call add_note; then close.'
else:
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'NOT recorded. Do not say it is recorded. If this was the FIRST try for this product, call create_promise again now with exactly the same values. If it was the SECOND failed try, say you could not record the promise for this product, call add_note for it with reason service_error, then continue with the other products.'
""")

NOTE_POST = hook("""
if ok or 'already' in err or 'exists' in err:
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Note saved. Never note this product again. Continue with the next product in order; if every product is handled, give the closing words and call close_call per the closing rule.'
else:
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The note failed. Call add_note once more with the same values.'
""")

TRANSFER_POST = hook("""
if ok:
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'TRANSFERRED. Do NOT call add_note or create_promise. Say thank you and goodbye, then call close_call with outcome transferred and reason restructuring (queue restructuring), human (queue general) or support (queue support).'
else:
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The transfer failed. Call transfer_to_agent once more with the same queue.'
""")

CALLBACK_POST = hook("""
if ok:
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Callback booked. Thank them, say goodbye, call close_call with outcome not_reached and reason callback.'
else:
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'NOT booked. Call schedule_callback once more with the same values. If it fails again, say it could not be booked, thank them and close with not_reached and reason no_callback.'
""")

CLOSE_POST = hook("""
if ok:
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The call is closed. Say nothing more.'
else:
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'close_call failed. Call close_call once more with the same values.'
""")

CLOSE_PRE = """try:
    b = config.get('body')
    if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get('outcome') in ('promise', 'paid'):
        b.pop('reason', None)
except Exception:
    pass
"""


def close_tool(outcomes, reasons, desc):
    props = {"outcome": {"type": "string", "enum": outcomes, "default": "{{outcome}}", "description": desc},
             "reason": {"type": "string", "enum": reasons, "default": "{{reason}}", "description": "The reason that goes with the outcome. Leave empty for promise and paid."}}
    return api_tool("close_call", "End the call. CALL it exactly once, as the very last tool call, in the same turn as your thank-you and goodbye. " + desc,
                    props, ["outcome"], retries=0, post=CLOSE_POST, pre=CLOSE_PRE)


def transfer_tool(queues, desc):
    return api_tool("transfer_to_agent", desc, {"queue": {"type": "string", "enum": queues, "default": "{{queue}}", "description": "restructuring = new payment plan or lower instalments; general = the customer insists on a human; support = hardship and accepted support."}},
                    ["queue"], retries=0, post=TRANSFER_POST)


END_T = {"target_node": "end", "description": "the call was closed", "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [
    {"variable": "close_call_response.data.ok", "operator": "equals", "operand": "true"},
    {"variable": "close_call_response.data.ok", "operator": "equals", "operand": "True"}]}}

FORBID = 'Before identity is verified NEVER say any of these words or hint at them: "collections", "debt", "payment", "owe", "late", "overdue", "account", "loan", "credit card", "product". If asked what the call is about, say only that it is a personal matter for {{title}} {{last_name}}.'

SYSTEM = """You are Freya Bank's digital assistant on an outbound phone call. Speak English. Be brief and polite: one or two short sentences per turn, ONE question per turn.
After every tool result, read what_to_do_next and do it in the same turn. Never end a turn with nothing said. Call one tool at a time.
Address the customer as {{title}} {{last_name}}.
If asked whether you are a robot or an AI: say you are Freya Bank's digital assistant, then continue with your current question.
If asked whether this is a scam: say they can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number, then continue with your current question.
If the person asks for a human: the first time ask whether you can help them first. If they insist, call transfer_to_agent with queue general, then close as transferred with reason human.
A question you cannot answer from your facts or tools: say you do not have that information. Never invent figures, dates or reasons.
Never claim an action happened unless its tool returned ok. Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or any other term.
Before close_call always thank the customer and say goodbye, in the same turn as the close_call call. close_call is always the last tool call."""

OPENING = "Hello, this is Freya Bank's digital assistant calling. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?"

GREET_TASK = FORBID + """
You asked whether you are speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}. No tool call except close_call and transfer_to_agent is allowed here.
- Only "yes", "that's me", "speaking" or the customer's own name counts as confirmation. "Hello", "go ahead", "who is this" do NOT.
- If it is not a confirmation (or they asked a question; answer it first per the rules), ask again exactly: "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?" This is your second and last ask. If still unclear after the second ask: thank them, say goodbye, call close_call with outcome not_reached, reason unclear.
- If they say this number does not belong to that person: apologise, say goodbye, close_call not_reached / wrong_number.
- If they say the customer has died: say "I am sorry for your loss." Ask nothing else, say goodbye, close_call not_reached / deceased.
- If the person refuses to talk twice: thank them, goodbye, close_call not_verified / declined."""

THIRD_TASK = FORBID + """
Someone other than {{title}} {{last_name}} is on the line. Do not say why you are calling. Do not answer any question about the customer or any money matter, even if they offer to pay; say only that it is a personal matter. Ask when {{title}} {{last_name}} can be reached.
{{callback_facts}}
- If they name a day and time inside the allowed slots: call schedule_callback with date YYYY-MM-DD and time HH:MM (24h). Then thank, goodbye, close_call not_reached / callback.
- If the day or time is outside the slots: ask ONCE for another time, naming the allowed window (today or the next business day, between 10:00 and 19:00). If the second answer is also outside, do not schedule: thank, goodbye, close_call not_reached / no_callback. Also no_callback if they give no time.
- If they say the number does not belong to the customer: close_call not_reached / wrong_number.
- If they say the customer has died: say "I am sorry for your loss.", ask nothing else, goodbye, close_call not_reached / deceased."""

IDENTITY_TASK = FORBID + """
The customer confirmed who they are. Check identity with two security questions, one at a time.
1. Say that for security you need to ask two questions, and ask for their date of birth. When they answer, call verify_identity with field date_of_birth and answer as YYYY-MM-DD. A date given only as numbers is day, then month, then year (03/06/1987 = 1987-06-03). Convert spoken dates yourself.
2. Then ask for the last four digits of the phone number on file and call verify_identity with field phone_last4 and the four digits.
Follow what_to_do_next after each result. Never reveal what is on file.
- Customers often give an answer in PIECES over several turns ("nineteen October" then "nineteen eighty three"; "forty four" then "ten" = 4410). Combine the pieces of the current answer. If the answer is not complete yet, reply only "Yes, go on." (do NOT repeat the question). As soon as you have a full date or four digits, call verify_identity.
- If they do not want to answer, or ask what the call is about instead of answering: explain ONCE that the questions protect their account and ask again. If they refuse again or ask again: thank, goodbye, close_call not_verified / declined.
- A request for a human follows the system rule (transfer queue general, close transferred / human)."""

COLLECT_TASK = """Identity is verified. You have already said this aloud: "{{debt_statement}}"

ACCOUNT FACTS (one line per product, in order):
{{account_facts}}

{{date_facts}}
DATE ANSWERS: when the customer names a day, find it here and do exactly what its line says for each product:
{{date_answers}}

STRICT ORDER OF THE CALL (never skip a step):
1. Negotiate every product, one at a time, in account order, until each has an agreed promise or its persuasion attempts are all used (or it is paid/dispute/hardship).
2. Read ALL agreed promises back in ONE message ending with "Do you confirm?" and WAIT for the customer's answer.
3. Only after a clear yes: create_promise, one per agreed product.
4. add_note for each product without a promise.
5. Thank, say goodbye, and call close_call in that same message.
NEVER call create_promise in the turn where the customer agrees to a date or amount: first do step 2 and wait.
Example: "I'll pay the card tomorrow, not the other two" = card agreed for tomorrow (check DATE ANSWERS); then the second product: make its attempt 1; if refused and it has attempt 2, make attempt 2; then the third product the same way; only then step 2.

HOW TO NEGOTIATE
- The question about paying today is asked ONCE for all products (already asked). If yes for all: the promise is the full amount of every product dated today.
- If not all today: go through the products one by one in the order above. For each product start at its attempt 1. Never ask about today again.
- Always ask for the full past-due amount first. NEVER ask "how much can you pay?" - you propose every amount.
- Customer names a date: use DATE ANSWERS. A vague period ("next week", "end of month", "when my salary comes"): ask once for the exact day; a named day then goes through DATE ANSWERS; if still none, propose that product's deadline.
- "Next <weekday>" = that weekday in the following calendar week; "this <weekday>" = in the current week.
- If the customer names ONE date for everything and it is after one product's deadline, that product gets its own deadline and the others keep the named date; say so in the read-back.
- Full amount too much: offer the product's floor once and say the rest stays overdue. Amount from floor to full (inclusive): accept. Below floor: say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once.
- A proposed date or amount is never a refusal.
- Flat refusal, non-answer, refusing the floor, refusing the deadline offer: that uses one persuasion attempt for that product. Make the product's next attempt exactly as written in ACCOUNT FACTS. When its attempts are used up, stop (never repeat a refused offer): that product is refused. When several products are refused in one sentence, still go through them one at a time with their attempts.
- Illness, death in the family or job loss: one short sentence of sympathy, NO persuasion; offer to connect them with the customer support team. Accept: transfer_to_agent queue support, close transferred / support. Decline: the remaining unpromised products get note hardship. If they still name a date or amount themselves, handle it normally.
- "I already paid" (this past-due amount) for a product: say payments can take one business day to appear; no promise for it; it gets note paid; continue with the other products.
- "Not mine" / "never had it" / "closed or paid off in the past": do not argue; no promise; note dispute; continue with the others.
- New payment plan or lower instalments: do not describe a plan. Do NOT record any agreed-but-unrecorded promise. Call transfer_to_agent queue restructuring, close transferred / restructuring.
- On ANY transfer never call add_note, before or after it.
- Customer says twice they do not want to talk: remaining products get note refused, then close.
- Recorded promises cannot be changed or cancelled; they can change it in the mobile app.

READ-BACK AND RECORDING
- When every product is settled (promise agreed or no promise), read ALL agreed promises back together in ONE message in future tense: "To confirm: <product> <amount> on <weekday day month>; <next product> ... Do you confirm?" Do not use the words recorded, booked, saved, registered, set up or done before create_promise returned ok.

    "tools": [close_tool(["not_reached", "not_verified", "transferred"], ["unclear", "wrong_number", "deceased", "declined", "human"],

import json, subprocess, sys

SKILL = ".claude/skills/build-phone-agent"
SERVER = "https://freya-team-bank-mock.metehan-freya.workers.dev/voice/v1"


def code_of(snippet, out):
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, SKILL + "/scripts/build_code.py", snippet, "--out", out], check=True)
    return open(out, encoding="utf-8").read()


CARDS_CODE = code_of("out/final_cards_snippet.py", "out/final_cards_code.txt")
RESOLVE_CODE = code_of("out/final_resolve_snippet.py", "out/final_resolve_code.txt")
READING_CODE = code_of("out/final_reading_snippet.py", "out/final_reading_code.txt")
WEEKDONE_CODE = code_of("out/final_weekdone_snippet.py", "out/final_weekdone_code.txt")


def code_node(name, code, target, transitions=None):
    return {"name": name, "node_type": "code", "passthrough": True, "passthrough_default_transition": target,
            "on_enter": {"type": "silent"},
            "pre_actions": [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "code_exec", "handler": "__function__:code_exec",
                "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
                    "code": {"type": "string", "default": code},
                    "timeout_ms": {"type": "number", "default": 10000}}}}}],
            "transitions": (transitions or []) + [{"target_node": target, "description": "always", "condition": {"operator": "always"}}]}


WRAP = """try:
    b = config.get('body')
    if isinstance(b, str):
        b = json.loads(b)
    if isinstance(b, dict) and 'data' not in b:
        fields = dict(b)
        call = dict(lang='tr')
        config['body'] = json.dumps(dict(data=fields, call=call))
        h = config.get('headers')
        if not isinstance(h, dict):
            h = dict()
        h['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
        h['Accept'] = 'application/json'
        config['headers'] = h
except Exception:
    pass
"""


def api_tool(name, path, desc, props, required, retries=0, post="", timeout=20000):
    t = {"type": "function", "config": {"timeoutMs": timeout, "maxRetries": retries},
         "function": {"name": name, "handler": "__function__:api_call", "description": desc,
                      "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
                          "url": {"type": "string", "default": SERVER + "/" + path},
                          "method": {"type": "string", "default": "POST"},
                          "headers": {"type": "object", "properties": {"Content-Type": {"type": "string", "default": "application/json"}}},
                          "body": {"type": "object", "properties": props, "required": required}}}},
         "pre_process_code": WRAP}
    if post:
        t["post_process_code"] = post
    return t


def hook(body):
    lines = ["try:", "    if isinstance(result, dict):",
             "        d = result.get('data')", "        if not isinstance(d, dict):", "            d = dict()",
             "            result['data'] = d",
             "        r = d.get('result')", "        if not isinstance(r, dict):", "            r = dict()",
             "        inner = d.get('data')", "        if not isinstance(inner, dict):", "            inner = dict()",
             "        ok = str(r.get('returnCode')) == '1' and int(result.get('status_code') or 200) < 400"]
    lines += ["        " + l for l in body.strip("\n").split("\n")]
    lines += ["except Exception:", "    pass", ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)


DATEFN = """MON = ['Ocak', 'Şubat', 'Mart', 'Nisan', 'Mayıs', 'Haziran', 'Temmuz', 'Ağustos', 'Eylül', 'Ekim', 'Kasım', 'Aralık']
def sd(s):
    p = str(s or '').split('.')
    if len(p) != 3:
        return str(s or '')
    return str(int(p[0])) + ' ' + MON[int(p[1]) - 1] + ' ' + p[2]
"""

SELECT_POST = hook("""
if ok and inner.get('cardNumberLast4'):
    d['route'] = 'ok'
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Kart bulundu. Hiçbir şey söyleme; borç okuması otomatik gelecek.'
else:
    d['route'] = 'error'
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Servis hatası.'
""")

DECIDE_POST = hook(DATEFN + """
if ok and inner.get('statementDate'):
    d['route'] = 'preview'
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Önizleme hazır (henüz HİÇBİR ŞEY değişmedi). Ortak ekstre cümlesi varsa önce onu söyle. Sonra aynen söyle: "Yeni hesap kesim haftanız her ayın <seçilen hafta>. haftası olacak. Yeni hesap kesim tarihiniz ' + sd(inner.get('statementDate')) + ', son ödeme tarihiniz ' + sd(inner.get('statementDueDate')) + ' olacak. Onaylıyor musunuz?" ve cevabı bekle. statement_week_change yalnızca net bir "evet" sonrasında çağrılır.'
else:
    d['route'] = 'error'
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Servis hatası.'
""")

CHANGE_POST = hook("""
if ok and str(inner.get('exitState')) == 'OK' and str(inner.get('responseCode')) in ('0', '0.0'):
    d['route'] = 'done'
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Değişiklik yapıldı. Hiçbir şey söyleme; sonuç cümlesi otomatik okunacak.'
else:
    d['route'] = 'error'
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Değişiklik YAPILAMADI.'
""")

SEND_POST = hook("""
if ok and str(inner.get('exitState')).upper() == 'DONE':
    d['route'] = 'sent'
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Gönderildi. Hiçbir şey söyleme; sonuç cümlesi otomatik okunacak.'

def hook(body):
    lines = ["try:", "    if isinstance(result, dict):",
             "        d = result.get('data')", "        if not isinstance(d, dict):", "            d = dict()",
             "            result['data'] = d",
             "        r = d.get('result')", "        if not isinstance(r, dict):", "            r = dict()",
             "        inner = d.get('data')", "        if not isinstance(inner, dict):", "            inner = dict()",
             "        ok = str(r.get('returnCode')) == '1' and int(result.get('status_code') or 200) < 400"]
    lines += ["        " + l for l in body.strip("\n").split("\n")]
    lines += ["except Exception:", "    pass", ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)

def fetch_node(name, tool, target):
    return {"name": name, "node_type": "api_request", "passthrough": True, "passthrough_default_transition": target,
            "on_enter": {"type": "silent"}, "pre_actions": [tool],
            "transitions": [{"target_node": target, "description": "always", "condition": {"operator": "always"}}]}


def eq(var, val):
    return {"logic": "or", "conditions": [{"variable": var, "operator": "equals", "operand": val}]}


def T(target, var, val, desc):
    return {"target_node": target, "description": desc, "condition": eq(var, val)}


def end_node(name, text):
    return {"name": name, "node_type": "end_call", "on_enter": {"type": "silent"}, "disable_inactivity_monitor": True, "transitions": [],
            "terminal": {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "end_" + name, "handler": "__function__:end_call",
                         "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
                             "message_mode": {"type": "string", "default": "custom"},
                             "spoken_message": {"type": "string", "default": text}}}}}}

def code_of(snippet, out):

    return open(out, encoding="utf-8").read()

except Exception:

def hook(body):
    lines = ["try:", "    if isinstance(result, dict):", "        result.pop('header', None)",
             "        body = result.get('data')", "        if not isinstance(body, dict):", "            body = dict()",
             "            result['data'] = body",
             "        inner = body.get('data') if isinstance(body.get('data'), dict) else dict()",
             "        res = body.get('result') if isinstance(body.get('result'), dict) else dict()",
             "        code = str(res.get('returnCode') or res.get('code') or '')",
             "        sc = int(result.get('status_code') or 200)",
             "        ok = sc < 400 and code == '1'",
             "        d = body"]
    lines += ["        " + l for l in body.strip("\n").split("\n")]
    lines += ["except Exception:", "    pass", ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def api_tool(name, path, desc, props, required, post="", retries=0, timeout=20000):
    t = {"type": "function", "config": {"timeoutMs": timeout, "maxRetries": retries},
         "function": {"name": name, "handler": "__function__:api_call", "description": desc,
                      "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
                          "url": {"type": "string", "default": SERVER + "/" + path},
                          "method": {"type": "string", "default": "POST"},
                          "headers": {"type": "object", "properties": {
                              "Content-Type": {"type": "string", "default": "application/json"},
                              "Authorization": {"type": "string", "default": "Bearer test"}}},
                          "body": {"type": "object", "properties": props, "required": required}}}},
         "pre_process_code": WRAP_PRE}
    if post:
        t["post_process_code"] = post
    return t


def code_node(name, code, transitions, default):
    return {"name": name, "node_type": "code", "passthrough": True, "passthrough_default_transition": default,
            "on_enter": {"type": "silent"},
            "pre_actions": [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "code_exec", "handler": "__function__:code_exec",
                "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
                    "code": {"type": "string", "default": code},
                    "timeout_ms": {"type": "number", "default": 10000}}}}}],
            "transitions": transitions + [{"target_node": default, "description": "always", "condition": {"operator": "always"}}]}


def eq(var, val, target, desc):
    return {"target_node": target, "description": desc, "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [
        {"variable": var, "operator": "equals", "operand": val}]}}


def eqb(var, target, desc):
    return {"target_node": target, "description": desc, "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [
        {"variable": var, "operator": "equals", "operand": "true"},
        {"variable": var, "operator": "equals", "operand": "True"}]}}


def end_node(fname, msg=None, llm=None):
    props = {"message_mode": {"type": "string", "default": "none"}}
    if msg:
        props = {"message_mode": {"type": "string", "default": "custom"}, "spoken_message": {"type": "string", "default": msg}}
    if llm:
        props = {"message_mode": {"type": "string", "default": "llm"}, "llm_prompt": {"type": "string", "default": llm}}
    return {"name": fname, "node_type": "end_call", "on_enter": {"type": "silent"}, "disable_inactivity_monitor": True,
            "transitions": [], "terminal": {"type": "function", "function": {"name": fname, "handler": "__function__:end_call",
                                            "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": props}}}}

def hook(body):
    lines = ["try:", "    if isinstance(result, dict):",
             "        d = result.get('data')", "        if not isinstance(d, dict):", "            d = dict()",
             "            result['data'] = d",
             "        r = d.get('result')", "        if not isinstance(r, dict):", "            r = dict()",
             "        inner = d.get('data')", "        if not isinstance(inner, dict):", "            inner = dict()",
             "        ok = str(r.get('returnCode')) == '1' and int(result.get('status_code') or 200) < 400"]
    lines += ["        " + l for l in body.strip("\n").split("\n")]
    lines += ["except Exception:", "    pass", ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)

content.text:
The agent is built and saved, but the version on the platform has never completed a simulated call. Every customer in the only simulation that ran failed at the first step. I fixed the cause I found, but the builder blocked a second simulation, so that fix has not been tested on the platform.

**What went wrong in the simulation:** the bank expects every request wrapped as `{"data": {...}, "call": {...}}`. Our requests reached the mock unwrapped, so the mock answered "customer number cannot be empty" and the agent sent every caller to a human agent. I confirmed with curl that the mock gives exactly that answer to an unwrapped body. My guess is that the wrapping hook failed because `json` isn't available inside it. I added an explicit import and a fallback that builds the request text by hand, and checked both paths locally. If that guess is wrong, every call will still end at the first step.

Two smaller points remain unverified:
- **Error answers from the bank:** I haven't seen how the platform passes a 404 or 500 to the code. If it passes nothing, the customer with no eligible card (93821776) may hear the "service failed, transferring you" line instead of the "no eligible card" line.
- **Third silence:** there is no fixed "ending the call" step after three silences. The prompt only tells the agent to repeat the question.

**What was checked:**
- **Debt readings:** I ran the reading code locally on the test customers from four of the six example conversations, plus a brand-new card and a shared-statement card. Example 1's reading matches the expected one word for word (amounts in Turkish words, full currency names, last four digits one by one). The other three have the expected amounts and dates.
- **Lint:** 0 errors. The lint can't match operation names inside paths like `/voice/v1/cards.list`, so I ran it against a copy of the API file with the same operations laid out flat (`out/final.lint_openapi.json`). The 5 remaining warnings are values I fill in from variables on purpose.
- **Validate:** passed.
- **Chat check:** timed out with a 504, which the skill says to expect when a call starts with API and code steps.

**How it's built:** the call fetches the card list, then the balance, statement week and e-mail address, all in code before the agent speaks. The agent reads a debt sentence built in code word for word, so it never computes amounts or dates. Every ending (main menu, human agent, service failure, e-mail sent, week changed) is a step with the fixed sentence from the bank's documents. The model only handles the conversation: choosing a card, the offer, the e-mail confirmation and the week-change confirmation.

**Before submitting:** run the four test customers in `out/final_personas.json` once more. Each should hear a debt reading rather than "Şu anda işleminizi gerçekleştiremiyorum".

Result: workflow_id `3a48d7a1-3fdc-49b6-87fa-79c4103538d0`, agent_id `00db39f0-25b6-47ce-a30e-ad7e868f705b`; lint passed (on the flat copy), validate passed, chat 504 (expected), simulation 0/4 before the fix and no re-run after it.

Files are in `out/`:
- `final.openapi.json`
- `final.spec.md`
- `final_build.py`
- `final.workflow.json`
- `final.export.json`
